answer.text: Reducing existing portfolio risk (e.g., NIFTY puts to hedge long equity)

explanation.text: The Logic: Hedging uses derivatives to reduce existing portfolio risk, not to speculate. The Trap: Other uses represent speculation or different purposes. Cross-Exam Context: Core derivatives concept. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Over-hedging eats into upside — match hedge size to hedgeable risk.
